url: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sysinternals/downloads/sysmon
accessed: '2026-09-12'
locator: Process creation Event 1 and ProcessGuid; network connection Event 3 and DNS query Event 22; Registry Events
  12/13/14, named-pipe Events 17/18, and WMI Events 19/20/21
archive_url: null
credibility: high
notes_zh: Sysmon 官方文档定义进程创建与 ProcessGuid、Registry 对象创建/删除/写值/重命名、命名管道创建/连接，以及 WMI filter、consumer 和 binding 事件。它支持连接
  Registry writer、WMI 持久订阅对象和后继进程，但不自动提供所有 Registry read、原始 hive、WQL 匹配事件、callback ID 或上层应用语义，必须与独立快照、WMI Activity
  和结果遥测结合。 官方文档另定义 Event 3 的进程网络连接和 Event 22 的进程 DNS 查询；Event 3 默认禁用，需部署启用并与代理及 DNS 日志关联，不能从该文档推断 C2。
notes_en: Sysmon documentation defines process creation and ProcessGuid, Registry object creation, deletion, value
  set and rename, named-pipe creation and connection, and WMI filter, consumer, and binding events. It supports
  joining Registry writers, durable WMI subscription objects, and later processes, but does not automatically provide
  every Registry read, raw hive, WQL matching event, callback ID, or application semantic and must be combined with
  independent snapshots, WMI Activity, and outcome telemetry. The official documentation also defines process network
  connections in Event 3 and process DNS queries in Event 22. Event 3 is disabled by default; deployments must enable
  it and join with proxy and DNS logs, and this documentation alone does not establish C2.
